concept.text: A proof or disproof that on a non-singular complex projective algebraic variety every Hodge class is a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles. Sources given: https://www.claymath.org/millennium-problems/ ; https://world-of-mathematics.com/blog/millennium-problems-overview/.

page.title: Resolution of the rational Hodge conjecture
page.definition: A proof or disproof that every rational cohomology class of type (p,p) on every smooth complex projective variety, a nonsingular space defined by homogeneous polynomial equations, is a rational combination of classes of codimension-p algebraic subvarieties. Type (p,p) means representability by closed differential forms with p holomorphic and p antiholomorphic factors.

goal.need: The conjecture asks which rational topological classes selected by complex geometry come from algebraic subvarieties. Clay designated it one of seven Millennium Prize Problems on 24 May 2000 and allocated US$1 million to its solution.

statements.context: This concerns the conjecture for arbitrary smooth projective complex varieties of complex dimension four.

completion.title: Clay accepts a complete resolution of the rational Hodge conjecture after its own examination.
completion.criterion: CMI accepts a complete solution after examination under §7(a)(ii). It either proves that, for every smooth projective complex variety X and every p, H^{2p}(X,Q) ∩ H^{p,p}(X) is spanned over Q by classes of codimension-p algebraic subvarieties, or supplies a counterexample CMI judges to resolve the problem under §5(c)(i). Qualifying publication, at least two years of community examination, and general acceptance are required. The smaller award for a counterexample prompting reformulation does not establish completion.
completion.set_by: Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Description and Rules, §§4–7.
completion.basis: Clay specifies the rational conjecture and separates community acceptance from its subsequent examination. The latter provides an externally adjudicated endpoint.

milestones.title: Every rational Hodge class of degree 2 on a smooth projective complex variety is algebraic.
milestones.criterion: For every smooth projective complex variety X, every class in H²(X,Q) ∩ H^{1,1}(X) is a rational linear combination of divisor classes, where divisors are codimension-1 algebraic subvarieties. Established: Deligne's official problem description reproduces the line-bundle argument proving this case.
milestones.set_by: The field's Lefschetz (1,1) theorem; recorded in Deligne's official Clay problem description, §2(iii).
milestones.threshold_quote: shows that c is the first Chern class of a line bundle.

milestones.title: The rational Hodge conjecture holds for every smooth projective complex variety of dimension at most 3.
milestones.criterion: For every smooth projective complex variety X of complex dimension at most 3 and every codimension p, H^{2p}(X,Q) ∩ H^{p,p}(X) is spanned over Q by algebraic cycle classes. Established: Clay reports this dimensional range as known.
milestones.set_by: The field's established low-dimensional theorem, reported in Clay Mathematics Institute's official Hodge overview.
milestones.threshold_quote: when the solution set has dimension less than four.

milestones.title: Every rational Hodge class of degree 4 on every smooth complex cubic fourfold is algebraic.
milestones.criterion: For every nonsingular degree-3 hypersurface X in complex projective 5-space, every class in H⁴(X,Q) ∩ H^{2,2}(X) is represented by an algebraic cycle with rational coefficients. Established by Zucker's peer-reviewed Theorem 3.2, published in 1977.
milestones.set_by: The field's rational Hodge conjecture restricted to cubic fourfolds; Zucker, Theorem 3.2.
milestones.threshold_quote: We derive the Hodge Conjecture for cubic fourfolds

milestones.title: A complete Hodge-conjecture solution withstands at least 2 years of examination and gains community acceptance.
milestones.criterion: A complete proof or resolving counterexample has qualifying publication, survives at least two years of rigorous examination, and gains global mathematical acceptance as determined by CMI. Unmet: Clay lists the Hodge conjecture as unsolved on 14 November 2026.
milestones.threshold_quote: The Proposed Solution must survive rigorous examination by the global mathematics community for a minimum of two (2) years.

not_found: Searches for Hodge-conjecture roadmaps and examination of Clay's description and rules found no prescribed sequence of partial theorems leading to a general resolution.

results.finding: For every smooth complex projective variety, all rational Hodge classes of degree 2 are rational combinations of divisor classes.
results.detail: The source gives the stronger integral result: every integral (1,1) class is the first Chern class of a line bundle, hence an integral combination of divisor classes.
results.quote:
This is the starting point of the proof given by Kodaira and Spencer [7] of the

results.finding: Rational Hodge conjecture: all projective varieties in dimensions below 4 are covered.
results.quote: The Hodge conjecture is known in certain special cases, e.g., when the solution set has dimension less than four.

results.finding: For every smooth complex cubic fourfold, all rational Hodge classes of degree 4 are algebraic.
results.detail: The source states the stronger integral result and recounts Zucker’s argument for rational Hodge classes. The criterion identifies Zucker’s result as peer-reviewed.
results.quote:
Theorem 18 Let X be a cubic fourfold. Then any integral Hodge class on X is
algebraic.
